hypotheses.persona: Office worker who works from home part of the day
hypotheses.rationale: The consistent presence of laptop at desk in morning and coffee mug appearing at desk at similar times across multiple days strongly suggests a work-from-home routine. The timing of meals and kitchen cleanup aligns with a traditional work schedule.
While possible, the consistent morning desk activity and structured meal times are more indicative of a work schedule than flexible study patterns.
The structured morning routine could fit, but the timing of activities (desk work during typical work hours) makes this less likely.
